text: This candidate for the Senior Full Stack Software Developer position received an overall fit score of 0.24. The strongest evidence for their application is their experience with "REST API", "React", "Git", "Docker", and "AWS". Key gaps include a lack of experience with nodejs, ruby, sql, and ci/cd, as well as having only 4.5 years of experience. Despite the low fit and missing must-have requirements, this application has been escalated for further review.
